---
name: Ticket
about: A lean, outcome-focused sprint ticket (see docs/process/HOW-WE-WORK.md §3)
title: "TKT-###: <title>"
labels: ""
---

**Goal** — one or two sentences: what changes, for whom.

**Why** — the problem this solves; link to DESIGN / ADR.

**Acceptance criteria** — observable behaviours (Given / When / Then). No class names,
test names or steps: those are agreed at kickoff and live in the lesson page.
- [ ] Given …, when …, then …
- [ ] …

**Out of scope** — what this ticket deliberately does not do.

**Learning focus** — one line: the concepts this ticket teaches.

**Points** · **Depends on** · **Sprint**
